title: Neural Controlled Directional Frame Generation for Sprite Animation
title_zh: 面向精灵动画的神经可控方向性帧生成

paragraphs.en: 总结：该文提出三个专家U-Net模型，实现精灵动画任意位置帧的可控生成，仅用280组三元组数据即超越通用基线。 Sprite-based animation remains prevalent in video game development, but production workflows require capabilities beyond traditional in-betweening. While existing neural interpolation methods can generate intermediate frames, animators also need forward extrapolation to predict motion continuations and backward extrapolation for editing and reverse-engineering existing sprite sheets. Current video generation models either operate on natural video content with stochastic diffusion sampling incompatible with production requirements, or focus exclusively on interpolation without addressing extrapolation tasks. We present a deep learning approach for controlled directional frame generation in sprite animation using three specialized expert models that share identical U-Net encoder-decoder architectures and several domain-specific modifications, including RGBA-aware processing, multi-scale flow refinement, pixel-shuffle upsampling, and alpha-gated blending. Each model is trained on different temporal orderings of the same curated dataset: previous (frames 2,3>1), middle (frames 1,3>2), and next (frames 1,2>3). We demonstrate that only 280 carefully curated sprite triplets enable effective training for all three directional tasks without requiring massive generic datasets. Evaluation on 42 test triplets using the FLIP metric shows that all three models achieve comparable quality--previous (0.26), middle (0.26), and next (0.27)--with no significant degradation for extrapolation versus interpolation, outperforming general-purpose baselines by 17-57%. With deterministic single-pass generation and compact model, our method provides the first practical solution for controllable any-position frame generation specifically tailored for pixel art sprite animation workflows, validating that quality-over-quantity data curation enables specialized deep learning for niche visual domains.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：该文提出三个专家U-Net模型，实现精灵动画任意位置帧的可控生成，仅用280组三元组数据即超越通用基线。基于精灵图的动画在电子游戏开发中仍然盛行，但制作工作流所需的能力已超越传统的中间帧生成。 尽管现有的神经插值方法可以生成中间帧，动画师还需要前向外推来预测运动的延续，以及后向外推来编辑和逆向解析现有的精灵图集。 当前的视频生成模型要么处理自然视频内容，其随机扩散采样与制作需求不相容，要么只专注于插值而不涉及外推任务。 我们提出了一种用于精灵动画中受控方向性帧生成的深度学习方法，采用三个共享相同U-Net编码器-解码器架构的专用专家模型，并包含若干面向领域的改进，包括RGBA感知处理、多尺度光流细化、像素重排上采样和Alpha门控混合。 每个模型在同一精选数据集的不同时序排列上训练：previous（帧2、3>1）、middle（帧1、3>2）和next（帧1、2>3）。 我们证明，仅280个精心筛选的精灵三元组即可有效训练全部三个方向性任务，而无需海量通用数据集。 在42个测试三元组上使用FLIP指标的评估显示，三个模型均达到相当的质量——previous（0.26）、middle（0.26）和next（0.27）——外推相对插值没有显著质量下降，相比通用基线提升17-57%。 借助确定性的单次生成与紧凑的模型，我们的方法为专为像素画精灵动画工作流量身定制的可控任意位置帧生成提供了首个实用解决方案，验证了重质不重量的数据筛选能够支撑小众视觉领域的专用深度学习。
